meta_description:
50K likes, 389 comments - markiplier on August 26, 2026: "GoPro Mission 1 ILS vs RED Komodo-X - Blind Test (answer in comments)

$700 camera vs $7000 camera! I’ve been testing the Mission 1 ILS against the RED Komodo-X and I’m consistent blown away by the results. Full review of the GoPro later today!

Settings are a bit different between each shot, I’ll expand in the comments if people are curious but tried to match them head to head on settings and lenses where possible.

No color correction besides REDWideGamut to Rec709 for the RED using Davinci’s builtin RED lut. Only the last shot for the GoPro was shot GP-Log because I neglected to set it for the other shots which are cinematic color profile.".
